meta.name: tavily-search
meta.description: Web search via Tavily API (alternative to Brave). Use when the user asks to search the web / look up sources / find links and Brave web_search is unavailable or undesired. Returns a small set of relevant results (title, url, snippet) and can optionally include short answer summaries.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 Tavily API 搜索网页并获取结果摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码或工作流中集成网页搜索能力
copy.tagline_en: Search the web and get result summaries via Tavily API
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate web search into your code or workflow

howto.what: 装上后，当你想搜索网络时，Claude 会使用 Tavily 搜索引擎代替 Brave 来查找信息，并返回标题、链接和摘要。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索网络、查找资料或寻找链接，且 Brave 搜索不可用或不希望使用时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索一下最新的 AI 新闻。
say.note: Claude 会用 Tavily 搜索并返回结果。

say.text: 查找关于 Python 编程的教程链接。
say.note: Claude 会返回相关链接和摘要。

say.text: 搜索今天的重要科技资讯。
say.note: Claude 会返回搜索结果，可能包含简短回答。

howto.what_en: When you ask to search the web, Claude will use the Tavily search engine instead of Brave to find information, returning titles, URLs, and snippets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to search the web, look up sources, or find links, and Brave search is unavailable or undesired.

say_en.text: Search for the latest AI news.
say_en.note: Claude will search with Tavily and return results.

say_en.text: Find tutorial links about Python programming.
say_en.note: Claude will return relevant links and snippets.

say_en.text: Search for today's important tech news.
say_en.note: Claude will return search results, possibly with a short answer.
